action.play-sound.name: Play Sound
action.play-sound.spatial.subtitle: Simulate a direction for this sound
action.play-sound.spatial.title: Spatial Position
action.play-sound.spatial.hint-headset: A headset is worn, so drag its two earpieces to set how wide the stereo image feels. Front and back cannot be simulated on a headset.
action.play-sound.spatial.hint: Drag the orange dot to place the sound, and the blue dots to match where your speakers actually stand.
action.play-sound.spatial.hint-default: This action plays on the default output, so only left and right balance can be simulated. Pick a speaker group to place sounds around the room.
action.play-sound.spatial.delay-subtitle: Delay each speaker by the sound's travel time. Needs two or more speakers.
action.play-sound.spatial.room-subtitle: Metres across the whole map, used to turn positions into distances
action.play-sound.spatial.headset-group-: Treat a device as a headset when it is worn rather than standing in the room. Detected automatically, but not every device reports it.
action.play-sound.sounds.subtitle: The sounds this key can play
action.play-sound.variation.subtitle: Randomly shift each press by up to this percent, so repeats sound less identical
action.play-sound.keep-playing.subtitle: Off: the sound stops when you leave this page. On: it plays until turned off, wherever you are.
action.play-sound.pause-mode.subtitle: The key pauses and resumes, keeping its place, instead of stopping and starting over.
action.play-sound.speakers.no-server: No sound server found. EasySound needs PulseAudio or PipeWire.
action.play-sound.groups.title: Speaker Groups
action.play-sound.groups.name: Group name
action.play-sound.fade-in.title: Fade In
action.play-sound.fade-in.subtitle: Fade sound in over 'n' seconds.
action.play-sound.fade-out.title: Fade Out
action.play-sound.fade-out.subtitle: Fade sound out over 'n' seconds, at the end of the sound or when a loop is stopped.
action.stop-all.name: Stop All Sounds
action.stop-all.description: Stops every sound started by EasySound, on every page.
action.stop-all.fade-out.title: Fade Out
action.stop-all.fade-out.subtitle: Fade everything out over 'n' seconds instead of cutting it off.
plugin.group.name: EasySound
action.play-sound.sounds.unreadable: This file exists but cannot be decoded
